summary: Four backpackers camping and hiking in Dominguez Canyon ran out of water after surrounding sources dried up and became lost; MCSO and Mesa County Search and Rescue reached them by ATV plus a 2-mile hike, and all four were rescued uninjured after a ~9.5-hour operation covering ~40 miles.
location: Dominguez Canyon, Dominguez-Escalante National Conservation Area
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office; Mesa County Search and Rescue
notes: Parent-opened Mix 104.3 article: call came ~9:15 a.m. April 28; four men, camping and hiking, without water since the day before. Date 2019 confirmed via kool1079 companion page age (~2019-05-01); 2019-04-28 was a Sunday ('yesterday Sunday' per kool1079). Dedupe: zero Dominguez tokens, zero Mesa rows 2019-04-26..30.
